address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the sensor. See [I²C Addresses](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#tmp1075_i2c_addresses) for more information. Defaults to `0x48`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

fault_count.docs:
**int**: Number of measurements. required for the alert pin to act. Must be between `1` and `4`, inclusive. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

function.docs:
**enum**: Function of the alert pin, either `comparator` or `interrupt`. Defaults to `comparator`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

limit_high.docs:
**int**: Higher temperature limit, in °C. Defaults to `127.9375` (the highest possible limit value).

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

limit_low.docs:
**int**: Lower temperature limit, in °C. Defaults to `-128` (the lowest possible limit value).

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

polarity.docs:
**enum**: Polarity of the alert pin, either `active_high` or `active_low`. Defaults to `active_high`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

alert.docs:
Configure the alert pin behaviour.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

conversion_rate.docs:
The interval at which the IC performs a temperature measurement. This setting also determines how fast the alert pin responds to temperature changes, and is thus independent of how often ESPHome checks the sensor. Possible values are `27.5ms`, `55ms`, `110ms`, and `220ms`. Defaults to `27.5ms`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor temperature. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [TMP1075 Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/tmp1075#configuration-variables)*
